notes: Contraction mirror of biology-replace-0013: removes the revision's original fact (the dolphin is a mammal). in_class is functional; the cardinality question asks 'reptile', not 'cartilaginous fish' (the revision's new value): 'dolphins are not fish' is a stored denial (285 hits) that would keep 'no' for any fish class after a clean contraction. Related near is the inverse reading (new relation class_includes, staged). Related far and both derived questions compare the dolphin's class with another animal's, with the other animal's class stored by name (bats, humans, dogs). Questions about nursing, gills or Flipper were dropped: 'dolphins nurse their young with milk' and 'dolphins breathe air' are stored on their own and give a route to the class that survives the contraction. Doubt: 'dolphins and X are both mammals' may be stated, which makes the comparison stored rather than worked out; counts requested for all three. The three same-class questions are alike on purpose: the class is the only thing the edit touches.
